DETAILS (Out of 25+ project, sharing a few below):
Bolttech (Insurance Fintech) – AP & AR Transformation
Situation: Bolttech was facing high invoice cycle times, dispute leakages, and limited visibility
into AP/AR aging across 18 geographies.
Task: Lead AP (P2P) and AR transformation to improve working capital, reduce
disputes, and standardize global finance processes.
Redesigned end-to-end P2P & O2C workflows with clear control checkpoints
Implemented dispute tracking dashboards (Power BI) for real-time aging visibility
Automated supplier exception management
Defined SLA-driven governance framework across regions
Worked with global and regional CFOs as well as CTO for project alignment, results and
execution.
Improved invoice processing efficiency significantly reducing human induced errors from 30%
errors to 10% errors in a matter of 3 months.
Reduced dispute cycle time from 14 days to a week
Delivered measurable cost savings and optimized DPO from 60 to 45 days average
Strengthened working capital governance across geographies
Reliance Retail – B2B Supply Chain Transformation (Fintech-Linked Working Capital Impact)
Situation:
Seller settlement cycles were ~6 months, causing working capital strain and vendor
dissatisfaction in a large B2B ecosystem.
Redesign settlement process and build a scalable regional supply chain model to reduce cost-
to-serve and improve cash flow velocity.
Built B2B Process Excellence function from scratch
Re-engineered Seller Settlement process with automated validation & reconciliation
checkpoints via integrated seller app.
Partnered with stakeholders to implement regional warehouse model to cut delivery timelines
and multiple WH costs.
Introduced KPI-based monitoring for returns and liquidation via central R&R dashboard.
Reduced settlement cycle from 6 months to 30 days
Improved vendor confidence and cash velocity
Reduced product returns by 11% in 3 months
Improved on-time shipment performance to 82%
– Store Disputes Automation (Finance Ops Digitization)
Situation:
Manual store dispute handling (AP-related) led to long resolution cycles,
reconciliation gaps, and high operational costs.
Task: Automate store disputes workflow and create a control-based resolution framework to
improve finance accuracy and efficiency.
Mapped end-to-end dispute lifecycle and identified root causes
Built automated exception management and categorization logic
Implemented control dashboards for dispute aging and error tracking
Established governance model with SLA-driven ownership
Worked on upstream fixes at Walmart's end to proactively identify vendors who need not be
charged under specific claim codes via HHD scanners.
Reduced dispute cycle time significantly
Improved reconciliation accuracy and vendor experience.
Delivered ~$0.5M in savings
Achieved substantial FTE productivity gains
